card.name: MT in drug abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letters "MT" opening an abbreviation in parentheses after a drug or drug class name, such as methotrexate (MTX) or microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (MTP). Also some other early pieces of M-words.

modes.label: MT abbreviation
modes.description: "MT" starts a bracketed abbreviation right after the spelled-out name.
modes.example: Microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (<<MT>>TP) inhibitors lomitapide ↑

modes.label: Start of M-words
modes.description: The first pieces of long M-words like myelodysplastic or methyl.

card.plain: It fires on the start of a short abbreviation like MTX for methotrexate, written in brackets after the full name.
